You are implementing Task 9: Profile screen

## Task Description

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/mobile/src/app/profile.tsx`

Simple placeholder: avatar/initials, name, email. Pushed as a Stack screen with the native header (root `_layout.tsx` already registers `profile` with `headerShown: true`, `title: "Profile"` — from Task 3).

Create the screen:

```tsx
import { StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import { Avatar } from "@/components/avatar";
import { ThemedText } from "@/components/themed-text";
import { ThemedView } from "@/components/themed-view";
import { Spacing } from "@/constants/theme";
import { useUserAvatar } from "@/hooks/use-user-avatar";
import { authClient } from "@/lib/auth-client";

export default function ProfileScreen() {
	const { data } = authClient.useSession();
	const user = data?.user;
	const { uri, headers } = useUserAvatar(user?.image);

	return (
		<ThemedView style={styles.container}>
			<SafeAreaView edges={["bottom"]} style={styles.safeArea}>
				<View style={styles.header}>
					<Avatar name={user?.name ?? ""} image={uri} headers={headers} size={64} />
					<ThemedText type="title">{user?.name}</ThemedText>
					<ThemedText type="small" themeColor="textSecondary">
						{user?.email}
					</ThemedText>
				</View>
			</SafeAreaView>
		</ThemedView>
	);
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
	container: {
		flex: 1,
	},
	safeArea: {
		flex: 1,
		alignItems: "center",
		paddingTop: Spacing.six,
	},
	header: {
		alignItems: "center",
		gap: Spacing.two,
	},
});
```

VERIFY the APIs first:
- `useUserAvatar` returns `{ uri, headers, imageFailed?, onImageError? }` — check the actual shape at `apps/mobile/src/hooks/use-user-avatar.ts` and use only what exists. If it returns more, fine.
- `Avatar` accepts `{ name, image?, headers?, size? }` — confirm.
- `ThemedText` types `title`, `small` + `themeColor` — confirm.
- `Spacing.six` and `Spacing.two` exist — confirm in `constants/theme.ts`.

Then create `apps/mobile/src/app/profile.tsx` with the content above (adjusting to the real APIs).

IMPORTANT: creating this file resolves the `router.push("/profile" as Href)` cast in `league-drawer.tsx` — after this task, typed routes include `/profile`. If typecheck now passes WITHOUT the cast, remove the `as Href` cast from `apps/mobile/src/components/league-drawer.tsx` (this is part of this task). If typed routes still don't know `/profile` until the route generator runs (dev server / `expo export`), leave the cast and note it.

## Steps

1. Read the component APIs and create `profile.tsx`.
2. Remove the now-unnecessary `as Href` cast from `league-drawer.tsx` if it typechecks without it.
3. `cd apps/mobile && bun run typecheck` — zero errors.
4. `bun oxc` from repo root — no new warnings in your files.
5. Commit:
```bash
git add apps/mobile/src/app/profile.tsx apps/mobile/src/components/league-drawer.tsx
git commit -m "feat(mobile): add profile screen"
```

## Context

Scorebrawl monorepo, Expo SDK 57. The root Stack (Task 3) registers `<Stack.Screen name="profile" options={{ headerShown: true, title: "Profile" }} />`. The drawer's "Profile settings" row pushes `/profile`. This is a placeholder (avatar/name/email only — no settings editing). `useUserAvatar` resolves the user's R2 image key to a URL + auth cookie header. Preserve tabs.

## Before You Begin

If you have questions, ask now before starting.

## Your Job

1. Create the screen
2. Clean up the cast if possible
3. Verify typecheck + lint
4. Commit
